wiki.title: Stephanie Sauder
wiki.extract: Stephanie Sauder (born November 17, 1958) is an American politician in the South Dakota Senate. She also served in the South Dakota House of Representatives. First elected in 2022, she has represented South Dakota's 4th legislative district as a Republican since 2023. Before serving as representative, she was elected mayor of Bryant, South Dakota. Sauder was a teacher at Hamlin School for over 30 years, during that time her family maintained an active agricultural operation. On November 5, 2024, she was elected as the state senator for District 4.
